correctness.rationale: For any tree seed-to-target route, infection time is a sum of independent unit exponentials. The full miss CDF follows via Erlang survival. Prüfer encoding exhausts all 1442 labeled trees through six and exact integer coefficient dominance excludes every nonmedian for all positive deadlines; the 7-site broom has unique distance median and a single positive polynomial crossing. A separate CTMC Laplace recurrence checked 21 rational inputs. The finite check is invoked only over its exhaustive finite domain.

value.rationale: The question contrasts two natural public-health sentinel objectives (timely deadline coverage versus mean detection delay) on minimal homogeneous contact-tree examples. The sharp size threshold and complete positive-time phase diagram explain exactly when the high-degree hub can beat the tree median for a deadline despite a worse mean; this cannot be established by a generic sensor-allocation approximation guarantee and supplies a falsifiable benchmark.
